data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**About Arada**
 Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Sharjah, UAE, Arada was created to build spaces that inspire, connect, and enrich communities. As one of the region’s fastest\-growing master developers, Arada has delivered landmark residential, retail, hospitality, and lifestyle destinations that redefine modern living.
   

  

 At Arada, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and high\-performance culture where talented professionals are empowered to make a meaningful impact on the communities we create.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Lead the independent Cost Control Audit \& Governance function across pre\- and post\-contract stages for Arada’s portfolio. Operating as a mandatory control point, this role ensures absolute baseline integrity, strictly audits commercial recommendations prior to package awards, and enforces rigorous governance over the Forecast Final Cost (FFC) versus project budget, disciplined cost governance, and financial visibility for all projects. The role drives cost strategy, reporting integrity, and team capability development.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Pre\-Award Independent Audit \& Gateway Control
* Mandatory Tender Sign\-Off: Review, audit, and provide formal feedback on all Pre\-Tender Estimates (PTE) and Tender Recommendation Reports before any package finalization.
* Independent Budget Verification: Act as an independent control point to cross\-verify procurement and commercial tender returns against the approved business case.
* Executive Gateway Reporting: Prepare and present concise "Gate Review" commercial analysis briefs to the Project Controls Director, CDO, and CEO, explicitly highlighting budget variances and risks prior to contract award.
* Design\-Stage Cost Checks: Monitor schematic and detailed design progressions to flag budget deviations early, forcing mandatory Value Engineering (VE) triggers if baselines are breached.
* Post\-Award Budget Governance \& FFC Control
* Budget vs. FFC Reconciliation: Own the monthly audit of Budget versus Forecast Final Cost (FFC) across all active assets. Identify and challenge hidden cost overruns or optimistic forecasting by project site teams.
* Contingency Drawdown Audit: Establish and enforce strict governance over project risks and contingencies. Validate that any drawdown request is backed by robust data and contractually justified.
* Trend Log \& Early Warning Governance: Implement and oversee an active Trend Log system to capture potential variations, design changes, and claims weeks before they manifest as formal commercial risks.
* Cost Monitoring, Reporting \& BI Automation
* Data Integrity Auditing: Validate and sign off on all monthly cost reports, cash flow projections, and cost\-to\-complete metrics, ensuring they represent a single source of truth.
* Executive Dashboards: Drive the development of automated, live Power BI dashboards for the C\-suite, focusing strictly on Management by Exception by flagging projects tracking outside a 5% variance threshold.
* Proprietary Benchmarking: Oversee the construction and maintenance of a live internal cost\-per\-square\-foot benchmarking database using historical data from completed Arada phases.
* Team Leadership \& Interface
* Internal Audit Team Management: Manage and mentor Senior Cost Controllers and Analysts, instilling a culture of objective, data\-driven financial auditing.
* Cross\-Departmental Interface: Partner effectively with the established Pre\- and Post\-Contract Commercial, Procurement, and Project Management teams while maintaining strict departmental independence.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
* MRICS certification is highly preferred.


**Experience**
* 12–15 years of experience in cost control, commercial management, or quantity surveying within top\-tier developers or international consultancies in the UAE.


**Technical Skills**
* Deep proficiency in enterprise cost management systems.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Strong Power BI dashboard development and reporting capabilities.


**Core Competency**
* Exceptional analytical authority with the confidence and credibility to challenge commercial submissions and present objective risk data directly to executive leadership.

data.raw_snippet:
**About The Role**
 The Design Manager is a central operational and creative role within M\+C Saatchi Sport \& Entertainment Middle East, responsible for ensuring the studio runs efficiently, design output meets the agency's quality standards, and every project is delivered on time and to brief.
data.jd_text:
**About The Role**
 The Design Manager is a central operational and creative role within M\+C Saatchi Sport \& Entertainment Middle East, responsible for ensuring the studio runs efficiently, design output meets the agency's quality standards, and every project is delivered on time and to brief.
   

  

 Reporting to the Art Director and Senior Client Director, the Design Manager sits at the intersection of creative production and project management. You will own the day\-to\-day traffic of creative requests and deliverables \- coordinating briefs, managing workloads, and ensuring the right resource is on the right job at the right time.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role that requires both design capability and operational discipline. You will produce and oversee creative work across the agency's client portfolio while maintaining the systems and processes that keep the studio performing at pace.
   

  

 The Design Manager will be a key figure in the day\-to\-day life of the creative team \- supporting the Art Director, working closely with account and marketing teams, and ensuring that creative delivery across all clients is consistent, organised, and to the standard the agency demands.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Traffic \& Workflow Management**
* Own the studio traffic system \- managing the intake, prioritisation, and scheduling of all creative briefs across the agency.
* Maintain a clear and up\-to\-date overview of all active projects, deadlines, and resource allocation at all times.
* Work with the account and marketing teams to brief in work accurately, ensuring all jobs are scoped correctly before entering the studio.
* Anticipate capacity pressures and flag resource conflicts early, escalating to the Art Director and Senior Client Director when required.
* Manage freelance and supplier relationships to flex studio capacity during peak periods, ensuring quality and consistency are maintained.


**Design Output \& Quality Control**
* Produce design work across a range of formats \- social content, campaign assets, event branding, presentation design, OOH, print and digital, to a high and consistent standard.
* Review and quality\-check all creative output before it leaves the studio, ensuring work is on\-brief, on\-brand, and production\-ready.
* Maintain brand consistency across all client accounts, upholding the visual standards set by the Art Director.
* Manage the preparation and trafficking of final artwork files for print, digital, and environmental use, ensuring all assets are delivered to specification.
* Oversee version control and file management across the studio, keeping asset libraries organised and accessible.


**Project \& Delivery Management**
* Track all jobs from brief through to final delivery, proactively managing timelines and communicating progress to relevant stakeholders.
* Identify and resolve production issues before they impact delivery, problem\-solving under pressure without compromising quality.
* Manage the review and approval process for creative work, coordinating feedback rounds efficiently and keeping projects moving.
* Produce clear status reports and delivery schedules as required by the account and client teams.
* Ensure all project documentation \- briefs, schedules, sign\-off records — is accurate, complete, and properly filed.


**Client \& Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Work closely with the wider team and departments to manage workload, set realistic timelines, and ensure creative capacity is allocated effectively.
* Communicate clearly and proactively with internal teams on project status, flagging risks and changes as they arise.
* Support the Art Director and Senior Client Director in preparing and presenting work where required.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with external suppliers \- print partners, production studios, photographers, and video producers and build a strong database of contacts, suppliers and agency friends we can tap into.


**Creative Team Support**
* Support and coordinate junior members of the creative team, helping to manage their workload and develop their understanding of agency processes.
* Contribute actively to the studio's creative culture \- bringing energy, rigour, and a commitment to standards to everything you do.
* Stay current with design trends, production techniques, and tools relevant to sport, events, and brand marketing.
* Contribute to internal creative reviews and play an active role in maintaining the quality of the agency's output across all accounts.


**Essential**
**ABOUT YOU**
* 4\+ years of experience in a design or studio management role, with demonstrable experience across both design production and traffic or workflow coordination.
* Solid design skills with proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite: Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign. Able to produce and adapt creative work independently to a high standard.
* Proven experience managing studio traffic and creative project delivery in a fast\-paced agency environment.
* Strong organisational skills with a methodical approach to managing multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Experience overseeing artwork preparation and file management for print, digital, and large\-format production.
* Excellent communication skills \- clear, direct, and confident in working across creative, account, and client teams.
* A high standard of personal output combined with a genuine drive to maintain quality standards across the work of others.
* Experience working with or managing freelance designers, external suppliers, and production partners.
* Strong interest in the sports and entertainment industry.
* Experience in a sport, events, or entertainment marketing environment.


**Desirable**
* Familiarity with project management tools such as Monday.com, Asana, or equivalent studio management platforms.
* Motion graphics or video editing capability: After Effects, Premiere Pro.
* Experience working with government entities, rights holders, or major event organisers in the GCC region.
* Understanding of the UAE and wider Middle East market, including cultural sensitivities and regional production requirements.


**What Great Looks Like**
 Success in this role means the creative and design delivery runs without drama. Briefs are clear, deadlines are met, quality is consistent, and the creative team has the space to do their best work because the operational infrastructure around them is solid.
   

  

 You are the person who knows where every job is at any given moment. You are across the detail without losing sight of the bigger picture. You care about the quality of the work as much as the efficiency of the process \- and you understand that one enables the other.
   

  

 You are proactive, not reactive. You spot a capacity issue before it becomes a crisis. You push back on a brief that is not ready. You maintain standards under pressure and bring the team with you when the pace picks up.
   

  

 You work comfortably across creative and operational worlds. You can sit in a briefing with a client director and a production call with a printer on the same day, and add value in both. You bring professionalism, consistency, and craft to everything that carries the agency's name.
   

  

 Built for pace and precision. Committed to quality at every stage. This role is suited to a highly organised, creatively capable Design Manager who wants to play a central role in one of the region's most active sport and entertainment agencies.
   

  

**Applications close on Friday, June 26, 2026\. No recruiters please.**
**About Our Local Office**
 We were born out of the need for strategic and brutally effective creativity in the region. With every successful campaign, we have grown, and cherry\-picked the best professionals to work with us from all over the region and the world. In 2012, we opened our Abu Dhabi office and expanded our team with our Dubai office in 2016 and then our Riyadh office in 2023\. From these offices we manage a number of local and global brands across the Middle East and Europe. Brutal Simplicity of Thought is the creative philosophy of M\+C Saatchi. It defines the way we work and the work we produce. We believe: It’s easier to complicate than simplify. Simple ideas enter the brain quicker and stay there longer. Brutal Simplicity of Thought is therefore a painful necessity.
   

  

 ABOUT M\+C SAATCHI GROUP
   

  

 M\+C Saatchi Group is a creative federation of companies who navigate, create, and lead meaningful change for clients across five specialist divisions connected through people, culture, data, technology and creativity, M\+C Saatchi Group aims to unlock new value for clients and leave a positive impact on the world. M\+C Saatchi Group’s work is informed by two core principles \- Brutal Simplicity of Thought and Diversity of Thought. Together they guide how problems are solved and integrated specialist teams are built. Headquartered in London, M\+C Saatchi Group have circa 2,500 employees globally. Our global operations span 23 countries with major hubs in the UK, Europe, Middle East \& Africa, Asia and Australia.
   

  

 OUR AMBITION
   

  

 At M\+C Saatchi Group, our ambition is to create and curate Cultural Power for our clients. We do this by connecting specialist expertise, powered by creativity, data and technology, to help build famous brands and solve the most complex business and societal challenges.
   

  

**M\+C Saatchi Group** 
 was founded in 1995 and is now the biggest Independent creative agency group in the World. Founded on one core principle, Brutal Simplicity.

data.jd_text:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.
   

  

**Job Duties**
 Under broad direction, plans and manages assigned real estate and infrastructure projects. Particular focus on coastal engineering and offshore island/causeway construction, but including design, construction, renovation, or replacement of company office, laboratory, manufacturing, warehouse, service center, and site infrastructure facilities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage projects located mostly across the Middle East and North Africa. Travel throughout these locations is required on a frequency suitable to the size and scope of the project.
* Reports to and receives guidance from the Regional Design \& Construction Manager and will be part of a small but efficient and high performing team.
* Determines, in consultation with Real Estate Services and business unit management, the definition and requirements for each assigned project \-\- including location, desired results, desired completion date, allowable cost parameters, funding sources, RES and business unit interfaces, and special environmental or regulatory considerations.
* Initiates value engineering and design optimisations of the requirements ensuring optimal use of space and costs.
* Prepares and seeks appropriate management approvals of project plan including work specification, schedule, and budget.
* Plans and manages project execution in accordance with project plan.
* Monitors and manages project schedule in accordance with project plan
* Makes mid\-course corrections to project schedule
* Advises Real Estate Services management and internal customers of schedule status, and seeks approval of schedule changes when required.
* Monitors and manages project budget and contractor payments in accordance with project plan. Initiates and seeks appropriate management approval of budget change orders when required
* Evaluates design and construction methods. Selects best standard methods for project execution. Makes appropriate adjustments to standards to meet specific project requirements.
* Manages project compliance with applicable building and fire codes, other applicable laws and regulations, and company Health, Safety, and Environment policy.
* Manages project compliance with company and Real Estate Services quality standards.
* Manages consultants, and contractors, as applicable, for execution and administration of Real Estate Services project activities and for execution of specific projects.


**Qualifications**
**Requirements:**
* Degree in Project or Construction management essential.
* Registered with PMI or equivalent preferred
* Degrees in Architecture, Quantity Surveying and Engineering considered provided there is practical project management experience.
* Minimum 10 years of experience working for a project management consultancy company or construction company.
* Experience in delivering Liquid Mud Plants or similar plant type projects comprising storage tanks, interconnecting pipework, pumps and associated items highly beneficial
* Self\-motivated, results driven and able to work independently to deliver projects.
* Willing and able to work under high pressure environment with short turn around times managing multiple projects simultaneously
* Competent in MS Projects and SAP with knowledge of Autocad beneficial
* Submit project profiles for the last three projects completed

data.jd_text:
**1\. JOB PURPOSE** 




 The role of the Resident Architect will be expected to cover the full Project Management, and FIDIC Resident Architect / DSA Contract Administration duties for post\-contract services, as detailed in the DSA PM scope of services documents and Responsibility Matrices.
 



  





**2\. JOB ACCOUNTABILITIES LINKED TO OBJECTIVES** 




 The Resident Architect may be required to fulfil duties as detailed below on single or multiple projects or working on strategic / special tasks and projects.
 



 The Resident Architect must work closely with their immediate supervisor and line manager to establish and agree work scope and responsibilities of this role on the specific project.
 



**The Role** 




 The role is to work within and lead a project, site team to the ultimate success of the project.
 



 This is DSA’s most senior Project Position on any project and role extends to looking after and maintain the best interests for DSA in terms of legal, contractual and or commercial positions on each project being responsible for.
 



 The role has 3 facets to it:
 


* Project Management
* Contract Administrator
* Architectural oversight



**Project Management Role** 



* To monitor and control progress and scheduling.
* To monitor the control of costs on all contracts as performed by the Quantity Surveyor / Commercial Manager.
* To Monitor and Manage the Change Management process.
* To coordinate the efforts of all Consultants, Contractor, Suppliers and associated parties with the project.
* To monitor the Contractor’s Logistics, and compliance with Health and Safety, and Environmental Management Plans.
* Report, on a regular basis, on the status of the project at all stages, highlighting performance issues, delivery deficiencies, corrective actions, and recommendations.
* To establish communication protocols, systems and procedures.
* Manage, monitor and maintain the performance of the DSA team and report and recommend any required allocations and or staff revisions to the Project Director.



 The RE will adopt an impartial and multi\-disciplinary approach in handling the project. The RE will display a global interest in the total project, encompassing the Design team, Construction Personnel and Client.
 



 During the Construction phase, the RE will give opinions and make recommendations to the Client that will influence and guide the works to assist the meeting of the Project objectives.
 



 The RE will also monitor the construction works; all health, safety and environmental matters; and the actions of the consultants to protect the Client’s interests.
 



**Contract Administration Role** 




 The RE is responsible for the complete administration of the DSA contract between the Client and DSA.
 



 This will involve providing all formal written instructions, Final adjudication on and recommendation to Extension of Time Claims, Cost Variation orders, dispute resolution, and acting on all duties and obligations under the contract within the limits of authority as defined therein.
 



**Architectural Oversight** 



* Ensure that the site teams are aware of and have a common understanding of their respective roles and responsibilities.
* Ensure that the Site team is suitably experienced and qualified to fulfil their respective roles and duties.
* Ensure the code of conduct of DSA site personnel is appropriate and professional.
* Act as ‘facilitator’ for the resolution of internal conflicts and associated challenges.
* Monitor the status of open items in the ‘Action Lists / logs’ to ensure speedy resolution of issues.
* Assist in monitoring TIE/RFI and other pre\-engineering responses to minimize cost implications and maximise project benefit.
* Assist in risk monitoring, control and responses/ contingencies.
* Assist the Site Architect in monitoring the drawing deliverables schedule and progress.
* Ensure training and mentoring is provided for all DSA site personnel where necessary.
* Ensure that the DSA site personnel have received a formal site safety induction and registration.
* Ensure that all DSA protocols for information transfer and site work are strictly adhered to.
* Undertake site inspections and quality audits at regular intervals and advise on quality issues.
* Monitor the quality control protocols and regime within the DSA site teams.
* Assist with Testing \& Approving when required design solutions proposed by the design team.



**3\. QUALIFICATION / EXPERIENCE / REQUIREMENTS** 



* Qualified Architect with minimum 15 years’ experience; 7\-10 years full time Middle East site experience is a must
* Multi\-discipline design experience and knowledge
* Hands\-on overseeing all construction works
* Excellent in English language \- written and spoken
* Experience with F\&B works
* Full project coordination
* Proficient with FIDIC Contract Implementation
* Must have tendering
* Experience in leading a multidisciplinary team is a must
* PMP/MCIOB certification is considered as an advantage
* Working knowledge of UAE Building Regulations and International Building Codes of Practice
* Must possess a tangible, technical problem\-solving ability



**4\. COMPETENCIES** 



* Plan \& Organise
* Active listening \& critical thinking
* Execution Excellence
* Excellent Communication (English)
* Good timekeeping
* Ability to work under pressure
* Team Player
* Management and Leadership
* Problem solving
* Collaborative



  





 Interested candidates can also send their CV to recruit.dxb@dsa\-arch.com, mentioning ‘Resident Architect’ in the subject line.

data.jd_text:
**About Us** 




  





 Sanipex Group offers to our customers unique lifestyle proposition for ultra\-stylish indoor and outdoor living throughout Middle East, Europe, Asia and Africa. Our reputation has been built over 30 years through our Retail, Trade, Project and Digital channels by offering a one\-stop\-shop for architects, interior designers, developers, retailers and private clients alike. We are a dynamic, creative team of people who are passionate about our customers and products. We thrive on comprehensive training programs that empower us to constantly grow and evolve. Imagine yourself flourishing in a positive, fun and driven culture to reach new heights in your career. With over 43 nationalities on board, we're deeply committed to fostering inclusion and diversity.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are seeking a highly organised, driven, and detail\-oriented professional to manage the opening, refurbishment, and ongoing maintenance of our retail showrooms, ensuring every project reflects the premium standards of an innovative, market\-leading Sanipex showroom. In addition to commercial fit\-out experience, we are particularly interested in candidates who have successfully delivered smaller\-scale luxury residential and villa projects, demonstrating a strong appreciation for high\-end finishes, bespoke detailing, and exceptional quality standards.
 



  





**Project Management:** 



* Plan, execute, and close projects in line with defined scope, timelines, and budgets.
* Develop detailed project plans, schedules, and resource allocations.
* Manage the opening and major refurbishment of retail showrooms.
* Monitor project progress, proactively identifying and mitigating risks, issues, and cost
* variances.
* Prepare and submit regular project status reports to the Merchandising Manager.
* Ensures minimal disruption to customers and seamless handover from project completion to operations.



  





**Operational \& Site Management:** 



* Oversee day to day operational activities related to ongoing projects.
* Manage and coordinate technicians, ensuring productivity and high quality workmanship.
* Coordinate with purchasing and logistics to ensure products arrive on site as required.
* Ensure display products are packed securely and transferred to the correct location.
* Ensure displays are installed in line with approved drawings and POS requirements.
* Liaise with the Technical Department on the manufacturing of display boards, whirlpools, and custom elements.
* Regularly assess installed product standards across showrooms and take corrective action where required.



  





**Stakeholder \& Vendor Management:** 



* Act as the main point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate construction activities with external contractors and vendors.
* Manage supplier performance to ensure timelines, quality, and safety standards are met.



  





**Compliance, Quality \& Continuous Improvement:** 



* Ensure full compliance with company policies, quality standards, and health \& safety regulations.
* Track KPIs and operational performance metrics.
* Drive continuous improvement in installation quality, operational efficiency, and showroom presentation.
* Execute all duties in line with Sanipex Group’s Environment \& Quality Policies



  





**About You** 




  





 You bring a minimum of 3 years of experience in strong project planning and execution capability, solid knowledge of project management methodologies, and proven experience managing risk, cost, and vendors within retail or showroom environments. You have successfully delivered smaller\-scale luxury residential and villa projects, demonstrating a strong appreciation for high\-end finishes, bespoke detailing, and exceptional quality standards. Technically competent in the installation of bathroom products and tiles, you combine operational excellence with strong attention to detail and quality standards. Highly organised and methodical, you communicate confidently across teams and seniority levels, perform effectively under pressure, and are proactive, self\-motivated, and committed to continuous improvement and delivering results within tight timeframes.
 



  





**What we can offer** 




  





 You will turn your career aspirations into reality. We will help shape your career journey through enriching experiences, learning, and development opportunities. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are passionate, innovative, and collaborative \- every day. We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive salary and benefits package.
 



  





**We Welcome Everyone to Apply** 




  





 It takes diversity of thought, culture, background, abilities, and perspectives to truly enthuse and excite our customers. We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future.
 



 We would like to thank you in advance for your application. Due to the influx of applications, we don’t always get the opportunity to speak to our candidates. Consequently, if you haven’t been contacted over the next two weeks then you can assume you have not been successful on this occasion.

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a Project Manager in Facilities Management to plan, execute, and oversee facilities projects and day\-to\-day maintenance operations across corporate sites. This role combines project delivery with hands\-on supervision of building systems, vendor management, and workplace services. You will ensure facilities are safe, compliant, cost\-effective, and support business continuity while delivering refurbishment, relocation, and infrastructure upgrade projects on time and within budget.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
**Facilities Project Management** 
 Lead end\-to\-end facilities projects: office fit\-outs, renovations, relocations, HVAC upgrades, electrical works, and space optimization. Define scope, budget, timelines, and quality standards. Manage contractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders from initiation to handover.
   

  

**Maintenance Supervision**
 Oversee preventive and corrective maintenance for MEP systems, HVAC, fire safety, elevators, plumbing, and building fabric. Develop and monitor PPM schedules. Ensure SLA compliance for hard and soft services. Supervise in\-house technicians and third\-party vendors.
   

  

**Vendor \& Contract Management**
 Manage FM vendors for cleaning, security, landscaping, pest control, and technical services. Prepare RFPs, evaluate bids, and administer contracts. Monitor KPIs, conduct performance reviews, and ensure compliance with service agreements and safety standards.
   

  

**Compliance \& HSE**
 Ensure facilities comply with local building codes, fire \& life safety regulations, environmental standards, and corporate HSE policies. Coordinate audits, inspections, and statutory certifications. Lead incident reporting and corrective actions for facilities\-related issues.
   

  

**Budgeting \& Cost Control**
 Prepare and manage OPEX and CAPEX budgets for facilities operations and projects. Track costs, approve invoices, and identify cost\-saving opportunities. Provide monthly reporting on spend, variances, and asset lifecycle planning.
   

  

**Workplace \& Asset Management**
 Support space planning, asset tracking, and workplace services. Manage building access, utilities, and critical infrastructure uptime. Oversee small works and reactive maintenance requests via CAFM/Helpdesk systems.
   

  

**Stakeholder Management**
 Act as primary contact for business units on facilities matters. Communicate project status, outages, and service impacts. Coordinate with IT, Security, HR, and landlords for integrated service delivery.
   

  

**Required Qualifications \& Skills** 
**Experience:** 
 10\+ years in facilities management with 5\+ years in project management. Experience supervising maintenance teams and managing multi\-site or large campus environments preferred.
 **Technical Knowledge:** 
 Strong understanding of MEP systems, HVAC, BMS, fire systems, and building operations. Familiar with critical environments like data centers or 24x7 ops is a plus.P
 **roject Delivery:** 
 Proven track record delivering fit\-outs, upgrades, and relocation projects. Experience with AutoCAD/MS Project/Primavera for planning. PMP or equivalent preferred.
 **Compliance:** 
 Knowledge of OSHA, NFPA, local building codes, and FM best practices. Experience with HSE audits and permit\-to\-work systems.Tools: CAFM/CMMS systems like Archibus, Planon, or ServiceNow. Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and vendor management platforms.
   

  

 Certifications Preferred: PMP, IFMA FMP/CFM, LEED, NEBOSH/IOSH, or equivalent.

data.jd_text:
**About Woods Bagot – Architecture for Worlds Ahead** 




 We design places that meet the challenges and opportunities of our rapidly changing world. Our commitment to exploration, impact and community creates enduring, forward‑thinking outcomes, unlocking humanity’s highest potential. With a global design culture devoted to creativity, resilience, and purpose – we ensure every project contributes to our client’s vision, inspiring future generations.
 



  





 Woods Bagot is part of the 7C Network. The 7C Network is an integrated network of design and architecture companies that provides “Total Place Design,” a holistic approach to creating transformative environments. It combines capabilities from its constituent brands – including Woods Bagot, ERA\-co, Impact Futures, and Customs Bureau – to offer services in placemaking, sustainability, architecture and interior design, and luxury concepts.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an experienced Project Leader to join our Dubai Studio and play a key role in the successful design and delivery of major projects across the Middle East and Europe. The successful candidate will initially lead a significant rail infrastructure project before transitioning to support and lead other key projects across our diverse portfolio. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Architect who enjoys working across complex, multidisciplinary environments and is motivated by designing and delivering high\-profile projects that shape cities and communities.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead the delivery of major projects from planning and design through to construction and completion.
* Initially provide leadership on a significant rail infrastructure project, ensuring successful delivery against programme, budget, and design objectives.
* Manage project resources, budgets, and risk throughout the project lifecycle.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, stakeholders, authorities, and project partners.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary teams, including architecture, engineering, planning, urban design, and specialist consultants.
* Facilitate stakeholder engagement, design coordination, and project review meetings.
* Ensure compliance with client requirements, local regulations, and project governance processes.
* Monitor project performance and proactively identify and resolve project challenges.
* Support business development activities and contribute to the pursuit of new project opportunities.
* Mentor and develop team members, fostering a collaborative and high\-performing project environment.



  





**About You** 




 You are an experienced Architectural Project Leader with a proven ability to lead the design and delivery of complex, large\-scale projects. Combining strong design sensibility with effective project leadership, you are skilled at managing clients, consultants, and multidisciplinary teams to deliver high\-quality architectural outcomes across all stages of a project's lifecycle.
 



  





**Qualifications and Experience:** 



* 15\+ years' experience designing and delivering complex architectural projects.
* Previous experience working on rail projects.
* Demonstrated experience delivering large\-scale, design\-led projects with multiple stakeholders and complex coordination requirements.
* Experience working on transportation, rail, aviation, civic, mixed\-use, commercial, or other major development projects would be highly advantageous.
* Strong understanding of architectural project delivery, including design management, consultant coordination, project planning, and contract administration.
* Excellent design leadership, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Degree qualification in Architecture; professional registration or chartership is desirable.
* Experience working within the UAE or broader Middle East region, with an understanding of local project delivery processes and regulatory requirements.
* A collaborative leadership style with a passion for mentoring, developing, and inspiring team members.
* Strong appreciation of design quality, technical excellence, and the delivery of innovative architectural solutions.



  





**How to Apply**

**About Al Marwan Group** 




 Founded in 1978, Al Marwan Group is a diversified organization serving the construction, heavy machinery, Oil \& Gas, real estate, development, and hospitality sectors across the GCC. The Group operates through multiple business units and subsidiaries, delivering integrated solutions supported by strong operational expertise and a well\-established regional presence.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 We are seeking an experienced
 **Project Manager** 
 to lead large\-scale roads and infrastructure projects across the UAE. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in delivering complex projects, including highways, bridges, tunnels, interchanges, earthworks, and utility networks. The role is responsible for overall project execution, commercial performance, stakeholder management, safety compliance, and on\-time project delivery.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Project Leadership \& Delivery** 



* Lead the planning, execution, and successful delivery of major roads and infrastructure projects, including highways, bridges, tunnels, interchanges, earthworks, and utility networks.
* Manage multidisciplinary teams to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
* Develop and monitor project schedules, resource plans, and performance targets, implementing corrective actions where necessary.



**Commercial \& Contract Management** 



* Oversee project financial performance, including budgeting, cost control, forecasting, procurement, and profitability.
* Administer contracts in accordance with FIDIC conditions, managing risks, claims, variations, and contractual obligations.
* Drive value engineering and operational efficiency initiatives throughout the project lifecycle.



**Stakeholder \& Authority Management** 



* Act as the primary liaison with clients, consultants, developers, and government authorities.
* Coordinate approvals, permits, NOCs, and project handovers with relevant UAE authorities.
* Lead project review meetings and provide regular progress updates to senior management and stakeholders.



**Quality, Safety \& Compliance** 



* Ensure full compliance with HSE regulations, project specifications, and quality standards.
* Promote a strong safety culture and oversee the implementation of QA/QC procedures across all project phases.
* Maintain adherence to UAE regulations, contractual requirements, and industry best practices.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




**Education** 



* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized university.
* PMP Certification or equivalent professional project management qualification is highly preferred.
* Professional membership or chartership (ICE, ASCE, PMI, or equivalent) is advantageous.



**Experience** 



* 15–20 years of experience in heavy civil engineering and infrastructure construction.
* Minimum 7–10 years of recent UAE experience with leading contracting companies.
* Proven track record as Lead Project Manager on infrastructure projects.
* Extensive experience in bridges, highways, tunnels, earthworks, deep utility networks, and complex infrastructure developments.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong technical expertise in infrastructure construction methodologies and engineering practices.
* Comprehensive knowledge of FIDIC contracts, claims management, cost control, and commercial administration.
* Proficiency in Primavera P6, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and ERP systems such as SAP or Oracle.
* Exceptional leadership, decision\-making, conflict resolution, and crisis management capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluent in English. Arabic language proficiency is an added advantage.
* Valid UAE Driving License.

 You are a confident and approachable operational leader who enjoys working alongside your team and takes pride in delivering outstanding results. You combine strong organisational skills with practical problem\-solving ability and remain calm and decisive in fast\-paced environments.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
* Lead and manage high\-complexity assurance and advisory assignments, delivering expert risk insights to inform and refine the department’s annual assurance planning and strategic priorities.
* Collaborate with the Section Head and Director to conduct enterprise\-wide risk assessments, develop risk\-based audit strategies, and prioritize audit coverage.
* Independently oversee audit fieldwork execution, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives, quality standards and timely delivery while mentoring team members on advanced techniques.
* Design, implement and continuously refine internal audit policies, procedures and methodologies, incorporating innovative tools like AI\-driven analytics to support long\-term audit function strategy and resource optimization.
* Analyze audit findings, trends and key performance indicators to identify systemic risks, recommend enhancements to clinical documentation, risk mitigation frameworks and overall governance structures.
* Develop and deliver targeted training programs for audit staff, cross\-functional teams and stakeholders on compliance standards, healthcare audit best practices and strategic risk management.
* Coordinate with external auditors, regulatory bodies and senior leadership to address audit findings, influence policy changes and contribute to organizational compliance strategies.
* Evaluate and test controls through data collection, validation and analysis to assess risk exposure and control effectiveness, identifying opportunities for business process improvements.
* Determine and apply optimal audit approaches, techniques and procedures to form objective opinions on control environments and strategic alignment.
* Present comprehensive findings, recommendations and strategic insights to senior management, influencing decision\-making and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
* Partner with business, IT and clinical stakeholders to co\-develop practical, sustainable actions that mitigate identified risks and align with Dubai Health’s strategic goals.
* Draft detailed audit reports, track management responses and verify implementation of agreed actions to ensure accountability and strategic outcomes.
* Contribute to periodic monitoring of Dubai Health’s risk profile, advising on emerging healthcare risks (e.g., cybersecurity in patient data, supply chain disruptions) to shape future audit strategies.
* Promote 'smarter' assurance practices, such as predictive analytics and automation, to enhance audit efficiency and strategic value.
* Maintain thorough documentation of audit work in line with IIA standards and departmental protocols, supporting knowledge sharing and strategic reviews.
* Coach, mentor, and guide Internal Audit staff (including Seniors and Associates) on industry\-leading practices, risk identification, data analytics, and strategic thinking in healthcare auditing.

 All Nationalities (Priority for UAE National)

 Unspecified

 Full time

data.jd_text:
**Manatal** 
 is an HRTech software service (B2B SaaS) company headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand. Manatal is one of the fastest\-growing start\-ups in the region and is backed by Surge and Sequoia Capital.
 



 Manatal has a global presence and is trusted by thousands of businesses in over 135 countries. Our goal is to transform the entire hiring process by making it simple, efficient, and enjoyable for recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates alike. Our mission is to offer the best\-in\-class AI\-powered technologies to empower small, medium, and large businesses in their staffing \& recruitment transformation.
 



**Head of Engineering Operations** 




 As Manatal expands into the enterprise segment, the operational demands on engineering are growing beyond what product squads can absorb alongside feature development. Internal requests, data migrations, bug triage, and customer\-facing technical work require dedicated engineering ownership to maintain quality and velocity across the organization.
 



 The Head of Engineering Operations will own this function. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, this role is responsible for all engineering work that falls outside of product feature development and platform engineering but is critical to customer satisfaction, platform reliability, and business growth. This includes building and leading a team, establishing processes and SLAs, and systematically automating operational workflows.
 



 This is a deeply technical, hands\-on leadership position. The successful candidate will write production code across our backend (Python/Django, FastAPI) and frontend (Vue.js, React) codebases, contribute to both internal tooling and customer\-facing repositories, and be capable of investigating and troubleshooting infrastructure\-level issues. This person is expected to operate at the same technical level as our Director of Engineering and Head of Platform Engineering.
 



 The role also serves as the primary engineering counterpart to the L3 support team (which reports into Customer Support), ensuring that technical escalations are resolved efficiently and that product squads remain focused on product delivery.
 



 We are looking for a candidate who is energized by high\-tempo environments, comfortable engaging directly with customers, and capable of managing multiple priorities under pressure. Strong judgment in prioritization and effective delegation are essential.
 



**Responsibilities** 




**Engineering Requests \& Customer\-Facing Support** 



* Own the intake, prioritization, and resolution of all internal engineering requests (data exports, credit adjustments, technical investigations, one\-off scripts).
* Define and enforce SLAs to provide customer\-facing teams with clear expectations and predictable response times.
* Serve as the primary engineering point of contact for the L3 support team, meeting regularly to unblock escalations and ensure timely resolution.



**Data Migrations** 



* Own the data migration process end\-to\-end: intake, scoping, execution, and validation.
* Design, build, and improve migration pipelines to significantly reduce turnaround times.
* Troubleshoot and debug migration failures across the full stack (application, database, infrastructure).
* Data migrations are among Manatal's highest\-stakes operational challenges and a key driver of customer retention.



**Software Development \& Tooling** 



* Write production code across Manatal's backend (Python/Django, FastAPI) and frontend (Vue.js, React) codebases to fix bugs, implement operational improvements, and connect systems.
* Build and maintain internal tools (Retool, custom applications) that enable customer\-facing teams to self\-serve on tasks that currently require engineering intervention.
* Maintain and update API endpoints and Open API documentation as required.
* Identify and systematically eliminate repetitive manual work through automation.



**Bug Intake, Routing \& Lifecycle** 



* Own the bug triage process: intake, severity assessment, routing to the appropriate squad, and lifecycle tracking through resolution.
* Define and maintain bug SLAs. Implement automated reporting to provide leadership with visibility into bug volume, resolution times, and trends.
* Manage vulnerability report intake and ensure findings are triaged and routed to the appropriate team.



**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Work closely with the Director of Engineering to protect squad focus by absorbing operational engineering load.
* Partner with Customer Support, Sales, and L3 to identify pain points and deliver engineering solutions.

**Who We Are:** 
 At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
   

  

**Summary:** 
 We're seeking a strategic and hands\-on
 **Head of Post\-Production** 
 to lead and elevate Huda Beauty's video content function. In this role, you will own the post\-production vision across brand campaigns, social\-first content, and marketing initiatives, while managing and mentoring a team of four in\-house editors.
   

  

 You'll work closely with Creative, Marketing, and Social teams to ensure best\-in\-class output, efficient workflows, and consistent on\-time delivery. This role requires deep post\-production expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to operate in a fast\-paced, high\-volume content environment. You'll be responsible for setting creative and technical standards, streamlining operations, developing talent, and ensuring creative excellence from concept through final delivery.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role: highly strategic, yet hands\-on when needed \- supporting shoots, defining technical approaches, and building a scalable ecosystem of videographers and freelance partners.
   

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Manage and mentor a team of 4 editors
* Lead, plan, and manage post\-production for a full slate of video projects
* Manage post\-production schedules and traffic control
* Create and implement processes and workflows that enable the team to work efficiently and independently
* Guide team development, helping junior members grow towards independence
* Oversee branded storytelling, ensuring delivery of best\-in\-class assets in line with brand vision
* Juggle multiple high\-priority post\-production projects in various stages, ensuring deadlines are met
* Identify workflow gaps in post\-production and lead continuous improvement initiatives
* Develop and refine a distinctive Huda Beauty editing style \- color grading, motion graphics/animation, sound design
* Work closely with the Head of Agency to build efficient project tracking, workflow systems, and deadline rigor
* Be a force for innovation \- integrate AI or other new tools into video production where appropriate
* Build robust storage solutions and archives
* Maintain a network of freelancers/vendors to scale up for projects when needed


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years' experience in post\-production management or a closely related field
* Deep understanding of all areas of post‑production: editing, color grading, VFX, sound design
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once under tight deadlines
* Experience working in agency, brand in\-house, or post\-production house environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive decisions across multiple teams
* Prior experience managing teams of 5\+ direct reports and freelancers

 PXGEO is an innovative marine geophysical service provider combining the strengths of ocean bottom and towed streamer seismic data acquisition techniques to deliver seamless subsurface imaging for a sustainable future.
   

  

****What's the role?****
 The official job title is Head of Sources and Mechanical Handling based in Dubai, UAE.
   

  

 The role is responsible for leading the seismic source, mechanical handling and NHV back deck activities of the Company to support the delivery of best\-in\-class fleet performance. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Mechanical handling, source and NHV technical support
* Manage a department of support staff (mechanical/Instrument and field\-based engineers) to provide first line technical and operational support to vessels and onshore departments as directed
* Maintain source, mechanical handling and NHV back deck specifications and standards for marine acquisition projects
* Develop, maintain, and improve the Company's seismic source, mechanical handling and NHV back deck technology and technique with a focus on environmental, safety, and operational efficiency and excellence
* Keep abreast of changes in source, mechanical handling and NHV back deck technology and proactively make recommendations to Management for enhanced service offerings
* Manage key suppliers of related technical services
* Monitor mechanical and back deck department spending, procurement and prepare budgetary forecasts for new technology
* Monitor mechanical and back deck related downtime across fleet and implement programs to reduce this as far as practical
* Develop and maintain Competency catalogue for the technical department personnel (onshore and offshore)
* Support Human Resources in the selection and development of mechanical and Instrument personnel
* Ensure that the Company management system is implemented, adhered to, measured, and improved by all in the related tech department organization
* Assist in responding to technical queries for tenders
* Assist in marketing in the related technical services to Clients.
* Frequent international travel, sometimes at short notice
* Occasional visits to, and onboard vessels
* Fulfill their assigned responsibilities as part of the Emergency Response team in line with the Emergency Response Plan and duty list as required


****Who are we looking for?****
* Has detailed knowledge of, and extensive experience with, marine seismic survey methods and technologies relating to towing and handling and sources
* At least degree level in an engineering or related discipline or equivalent experience
* As frequent travelers conduct vessel visits: BOSIET or FOET certification is required

**Enjoy a career, packaged with care, whilst helping protect food, people and the planet**
 We are a key global provider of sustainable packaging solutions. We’re on a mission to make all packaging recyclable, reusable, or compostable. Every day, we ensure the hygiene and safety of food and drink for people around the world. We are Huhtamaki.
   

  

 You could be part of our vision. Because it’s our talented people that make it happen. Our people on the shop floor producing innovative, sustainable products. Our people in our offices delivering excellence for our customers every day. It’s every one of us working together.
   

  

 We offer a place where you can feel safe, be supported, and make an impact so we can all focus on the future together.
   

  

**Your opportunity**
 We are looking for a Head of Finance, MEA, to plan, organize, lead and control the Finance activities for the Region in order to support the delivery of the required growth, revenue, profit, working capital, cash flow and EBIT objectives. You will be the finance business partner for regional leadership and play an essential role in providing financial information, analysis and recommendations to make strategically consistent and financially sound decisions.
   

  

 This role reports to VP MEA and to our Flexible Packaging Segment VP Finance.
   

  

**Where you’ll be**
 This role is located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Develop and execute the financial strategy for the MEA region, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives.
* Take full responsibility for financial reporting and controlling across the MEA region, delivering timely, accurate, and insightful analysis in line with Segment and Group reporting requirements.
* Lead and coordinate strategic and budget planning processes, ensuring clear targets, KPIs, and objectives are established and aligned with business goals.
* Ensure accurate forecasting to support effective decision\-making and long\-term planning.
* Oversee capital expenditure planning and monitoring, including project costs, approvals, financing, cash flow, and return on investment. Regularly review existing investments to assess their continued viability.
* Drive working capital optimization by collaborating closely with country teams to improve inventory, receivables, payables, debt management, and capital project efficiency, ultimately maximizing cash flow and returns.
* Identify and manage foreign currency exposures to minimize risk and protect financial performance.
* Review and enhance financial processes and procedures, ensuring strong governance, data accuracy, compliance, and operational discipline.
* Provide financial analysis and support for divestments, restructuring, and expansion initiatives, including the development of robust financial models for strategic decision\-making.
* Ensure effective implementation of business and productivity improvement initiatives by establishing follow\-up and control mechanisms to track progress, savings, efficiency gains, and value creation.
* Support continuous process improvements and ERP transformation initiatives within Flexible Packaging MEA.
* Lead the Finance organization in MEA, delivering high\-quality operational finance services and business controlling. Build a capable, well\-structured team while fostering strong engagement and collaboration, and supporting regional business priorities.


**What You’ll Bring To The Role**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field and / or a professional qualification (e.g., CPA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).
* Strong experience in finance leadership on regional or multi country level or global context preferably in manufacturing or FMCG environment.
* Proven experience in managing and leading finance teams and functions with a strong business partnering ability.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Resilience and willingness to win.
* Ability to assess, analyze and synthesize a great deal of information and simplify the complexities.
* Fluent in English, excellent communication skills with ability to establish credibility, respect and build strong working relationships.
* A leadership style aligned with Huhtamaki’s values: Care, Dare and Deliver.


**What We Offer In Return**
* Opportunity to make an impact: in this role you can truly bring value with your finance and business expertise to drive business performance, co\-develop the business strategy and direction while providing leadership to finance teams with build up talent and capabilities.
* A meaningful job: At Huhtamaki, we believe in protecting food, people and the planet. Our innovative and transformative solutions touch the daily lives of people everywhere.
* Development opportunities: We care for each other – and want to see our talent thrive and develop.
* Responsible employer: Sustainability is embedded in everything we do. We believe diverse teams fuel innovation. We invest in fostering an environment where everyone is safe both psychologically and physically and where diversity and inclusion are promoted through day\-to\-day behaviors, reinforced by our policies and practices.


 If this sounds like a good fit, then we’d love to hear from you!

data.jd_text:
**About Us** 




 Keeta, the international subsidiary of global delivery leader Meituan, is driven by a clear mission: We help people eat better, live better. Building on our parent company's 16 years of technological and operational expertise mastered in China, we are leading a global transformation in food and consumer product delivery. Since our start in 2023, Keeta has focused on creating value for every part of the communities we serve. We provide a reliable experience for consumers, enhance technology and operations for restaurants, and create more earning opportunities and greater safety for courier partners. This commitment to shared progress drives our journey from Hong Kong, China, across the Middle East and into Brazil, with the world ahead.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



1. Build and maintain data pipelines, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to support logistics operations — providing real\-time visibility across delivery performance, courier efficiency, and supply\-demand balance
2. .Lead deep\-dive analytics on key delivery metrics including ATA (Arrival Time Accuracy), order fulfilment rates, and last\-mile efficiency — translating insights into actionable recommendations for operations teams
3. .Develop quantitative models for capacity planning, workforce scheduling, and demand forecasting to support sustainable growth in the UAE market
4. .Own data storytelling for weekly and monthly business reviews — ensuring KPI visibility and driving alignment across cross\-functional stakeholders
5. .Partner with Product, Operations, and Finance teams to define metrics frameworks, evaluate new initiatives, and embed a data\-driven decision\-making culture
6. .Lead and develop a team of 4–5 data analysts — setting direction, building capability, and fostering a high\-performance analytics culture



  





**What We Need From You** 



* 5\+ years of experience in data analytics, with 2\+ years of team management experience.
* Proficiency in SQL and at least one of Python or R — with hands\-on experience building pipelines, dashboards, and analytical models.
* Strong background in internet, technology, or on\-demand platform companies — experience in food delivery, logistics, or last\-mile operations is a strong plus.
* Proven ability to translate complex data into clear business insights and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
* Fluency in both English and Chinese (Mandarin) — this role operates across a bilingual team environment.
* Bachelor's degree or above in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.



  





**What Makes This Role Exciting** 




 This is a senior leadership role at the intersection of data science and last\-mile delivery operations — with direct impact on how Keeta serves millions of users across the UAE. You'll be reporting into the Head of Logistics and building the data foundation that powers one of the fastest\-growing food delivery platforms in the Middle East. With a newly formed team and a high\-growth market, this is a genuine opportunity to shape how data\-driven decisions are made at scale — from the ground up.
 



  





**Why Join Keeta** 



* **Global scale, local impact** 
 — Keeta is Meituan's international arm, backed by 16 years of technology and operational expertise, and one of the fastest\-growing food delivery platforms in the Middle East.
* **Real ownership from day one** 
 — You'll lead a team, shape data infrastructure, and directly influence how the business makes decisions at scale.
* **Work with top talent globally** 
 — Collaborate with teammates from over 40 countries in a fast\-moving, high\-performance environment.
* **Accelerate your career** 
 — We move fast, operate across multiple markets, and give ambitious people the space to grow beyond what a traditional role could offer.

 Fleet Technical Management at Emirates comprises five specialized teams dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of service and reliability for our fleet.
   

  

**Airframe Systems:** 
 Handles mechanical systems including flight controls, landing gear, and air conditioning.
   

  

**Structures** 
 : Supports aircraft structures, including repairs and modifications for metallic and composite parts.
   

  

**Avionics** 
 : Manages avionics systems, including navigation, communications, and advanced IFE systems.
   

  

**Powerplant** 
 : Oversees engines and APUs, focusing on health monitoring and optimization.
   

  

**Cabin** 
 : Maintains passenger cabins, flight decks, and retrofits, ensuring top\-notch comfort and functionality.
   

  

 Each team ensures our fleet operates efficiently and safely, meeting all technical and service standards.
   

  

 As a Technical Services Engineer I (Cabin Technical and Reconfigurations) you will provide fleet technical management, continuing airworthiness management and technical support functions for Emirates fleet to ensure compliance to regulatory \& safety requirements, reliability, passenger comfort and cost effectiveness.
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Provide fleet technical management, continuing airworthiness management and technical support functions for Airframe/Mechanical Systems.
* Routinely evaluate manufacturers/regulatory authorities’ technical documents, taking appropriate actions and update internal engineering documents including Engineering Order and Special Engineering Workcard.
* Review in\-service data (e.g Tech log, Pilot Reports, Defects) and implement actions to improve fleet, engine, component and/or system reliability and maintainability, including optimisation of aircraft maintenance programs.
* Deliver technical assistance and operational support in disruptions scenarios including the handling of technical/AOG, troubleshooting, aircraft chronic and deferred defects and technical delays.
* Carry out Emirates Engineering design organisational activities such as but not limited to development of standard operating procedures, in house repairs, use of alternate parts, deviations from manufacturing documents by exercising Design Engineer (DE) privileges of Part 21 Design Organisation as appointed by Head of Design (HOD).
* Provide support and expertise for acquisition of new Aircraft and end of lease activities
* Act as a technical liaison with Aircraft, Engines and/or Component Manufacturers and internal stakeholders (e.g flight operations, service delivery) to address fleet significant faults, defects, design issues and quality escapements.
* Provide technical clarifications/justification to internal stakeholders in support of cost optimisation, contract negotiation, repair and modification processes.
* Carry out project management functions such as but not limited to major modifications, retrofits, cabin reconfigurations and aircraft phaseout requirements including preparation of cost benefit studies or budget requirements on changes/repairs with recommendations/proposals for approval by management.
* Review and analyse technical data in support of department KPIs, highlighting trends and making recommendation reports/proposal for improvement.


 Qualification
   

  

**To be considered for the role you must meet the below requirements:**
* Degree or Honours (12\+3 or equivalent).
* More than 10 years of experience in Engineering, Aeronautical.
* Degree in Aeronautical/Avionics/Mechanical/Electrical Engineering and/or holder of Aircraft Maintenance Engineering Licence for 5 years.
* Related Aircraft Engineering experience.
* Should have a minimum of 8 years in Technical Services function of which at least 5 years of experience pertaining to Emirates fleet type/aircraft systems.
* Knowledge of latest technical developments and industry trends on respective systems.
* Ability to analyse and synthesise technical information for implementation in cost effective ways.
* Excellent drafting/report writing skills.
* Demonstrable experience in managing complex tasks and decision making in a fast\-paced environment.


 Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary.
   

  

 Salary \& benefits
   

  

 On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also has an excellent leave and healthcare package. That’s on top of transport benefits, life insurance and more. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast\-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers

data.jd_text:
The College of Engineering (CEN) at American University of Sharjah (AUS) invites applicants for the position of the Head of the Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering (CHBE) starting Fall 2027\. The college is seeking a visionary academic leader with the responsibilities of ensuring smooth and successful operation and sustainable development of the department.
   

  

 The candidate for the position must hold earned degrees, including a doctorate, in chemical engineering or a related field. The candidate must have demonstrated leadership in research, as evidenced by her/his outstanding publication record. In addition, a demonstrated record of excellence in teaching, and in academic and relevant professional services is required. The selected individual will have the opportunity to develop and articulate a vision and long\-range plan for the department in teaching and in research strategy that embodies the relevant areas that are vital to the department and the region. Special consideration will be given to candidates with a clear vision and achievable goals that are in line with the college’s and university’s strategic plans.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The successful candidate must be a dynamic, collaborative, visionary and innovative individual with demonstrated leadership experience that can promote the continued advancement of the department. He/she is expected to have strong communication skills to effectively engage with a wide variety of constituents within and outside the university. His/her leadership style should include positive attitude, transparency, integrity, trust, fairness, promptness and collegiality. In addition to the general and wide responsibilities of the department head position, as partially outlined in the
 *Faculty Handbook* 
 , the selected applicant will be required to:
   

  

* provide effective leadership with well\-defined plans to nurture and elevate the standard of the department, accompanied with the development of short\-term and long\-term strategies in alignment with the strategic plans of the college and the university
* ensure high\-quality teaching as well as holistic development of the students, using approaches such as technology supported delivery, problem\-based learning, and other cutting\-edge trends in engineering education, in addition to leading the continuous improvement of the curriculum
* facilitate the conduct of innovative and cutting\-edge research of high\-quality and impact and promote multidisciplinary research with the optimal use of research funds and research facilities
* empower, mentor, promote, inspire and support faculty and staff to develop and sustain excellence in teaching, research and service
* foster a positive culture of innovation and entrepreneurship among faculty and students
* improve continuously teaching, research and service through benchmarking
* lead the department in achieving student recruitment goals by establishing and implementing recruitment plans for undergraduate and graduate students
* enrich the students’ experience via enhanced services, exchange visits, invited speakers, field trips, student clubs, professional certifications, competitions, conferences, etc.
* secure full\-time and internship positions and provide undergraduate research experience to the students
* participate in outreach activities, including maintaining ties and collaborations with alumni, industry, government, advisory boards, other university units and community members, and maintaining involvement in local and international professional organizations
* advertise locally and publicly the achievements and expertise of the faculty, staff and students of the department through web, newsletters and media exposure to enhance the academic reputation of the program
* collect data systematically and continuously from the department to plan and execute informed decisions
* ensure and increase diversity and equity in faculty hiring and student recruitment
* maintain and actively promote a positive, safe, transparent, fair, open, respectful, collegial working environment at the department, college and university
* interact and communicate effectively with individual faculty, staff and students (and parents) on a range of professional and personal issues
* represent the faculty and staff and convey their needs to the college’s and university’s administration.
* oversee the department’s operations including scheduling, advising, registration, lab preparations, budget allocation, compliance and risk management, etc.
* review and coordinate faculty course releases, sabbaticals and leave without pay requests
* conduct fair faculty and staff annual evaluations and provide effective feedback
* evaluate faculty and staff for promotion and/or rolling contract decisions
* lead and manage accreditation visits
* performing other duties as needed or assigned by the Dean


 Applicants should fill out an application form and upload the required documents (PDF) using the following \<a href\="javascript:aus\_external\_warning\_ShowExternalUrlDialog("https://acg\-apps1\.aus.edu/cen/empapp/apply.php?p\=CHE\-DH\-26\-01");"\>link. The required documents are a cover letter and a detailed curriculum vitae (including a teaching statement, a research statement, vision and goals for the department, list of courses that can be taught or were taught, and names of at least three references who would be willing to write letters of recommendation). Positions are open until filled. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
   

  

 The Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering has approximately 200 undergraduate students, 15 graduate students, 12 full\-time faculty and 3 lab instructors. Students and faculty represent very diverse backgrounds and nationalities; approximately 90 nationalities are present on campus. The department offers a Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering, a Bachelor of Science in Chemical and Biological Engineering, and a Master of Science in Chemical Engineering.
   

  

 AUS is located in the Emirate of Sharjah (about 15 km from Dubai). AUS is an independent, not\-for\-profit, coeducational university, serving more than 5,700 students. Further information can be obtained here.
   

  

 AUS is licensed and its programs are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the Ministry of Education's Higher Education Affairs Division in the United Arab Emirates. AUS has been accredited in the United States of America by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education (1007 North Orange Street, 4th Floor, MB \#166, Wilmington, DE 19801 USA) since June 2004\. The Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering offered by the College of Engineering is accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of ABET, \<a href\="javascript:aus\_external\_warning\_ShowExternalUrlDialog("http://www.abet.org/");"\>http://www.abet.org/.
