**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The incumbent will be responsible for driving the strategic direction of the organization's risk management practices for Merchant Risk (Acquiring). The role will work closely with the executive leadership team, risk management teams, and key stakeholders to establish a comprehensive risk management framework that balances financial stability, compliance, and innovation.
   

  

 Main Responsibilities
   

  

* Shareholder \& Financial: \- Serve as a trusted advisor to the executive leadership team, providing strategic guidance on risk management issues and initiatives. \- Lead the development and implementation of a comprehensive risk management strategy that aligns with the organization's overall business goals and objectives. \- Foster a culture of risk management and awareness, promoting the integration of risk management practices into all aspects of the organization's operations. \- Monitor and report on the performance of risk management practices and systems, making recommendations for improvements and driving the implementation of best practices. \- Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective staff and monitor exercise of the same. \- Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial \& non\-financial performance. \- Implements KPI’s and best practices for Merchant Risk (Acquiring).
* Customer (Internal \& External): \- Establish and maintain strong relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, including merchants, issuers, regulators, and industry partners. \- Ensure that customer needs and expectations are considered in the development and implementation of risk management strategies. \- Lead the development and implementation of effective communication and engagement strategies to educate customers, stakeholders, and industry partners on risk management practices and procedures. \- Provide expert guidance and support to customers and stakeholders on risk management issues and initiatives. \- Liaise with domestic Group divisions, departments, zone and branch management, and International branches and subsidiaries in identifying potential fraud risk exposure within existing systems, procedures and people, with end objective to minimize, prevent and remediate any losses incurred to the customer. (Fraud Risk SelfAssessment process linked to OpRisk RCSA’s). \- Support relevant Group divisions / departments in maintaining and enhancing procedural knowledge and card network compliance of fraud\-reporting and chargeback processing requirements. \- To assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s product and seek solution to their requests. \- Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time. \- Build and maintain strong/effective relationships with related departments/units to achieve the Group’s objectives. \- Provide timely/accurate data to external/internal Auditors, Compliance, Financial Control and Risk when required.
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory): \- Oversee successful implementation and maintenance of end\-to\-end Fraud Risk Self\-Assessment process, including roll\-out scheduling, response review and control gap identification, working in close unison with Head of Risk Control Self\-Assessment (RCSA). \- Ensure timely, effective and complete resolution of internal audit points, through effective co\-ordination between relevant Fraud Risk functions and other internal entities – i.e. Group ITD, Group Operations etc.... \- Coordinate with Retail processing departments to establish sound knowledge and best practice of card\-network chargeback rules in order to best protect cardholders and the Bank pertaining to liability rights and re\-presentment opportunity.\- Coordinate with Compliance function on the overall fraud risk awareness training for Group\-wide divisions \& departments, and maintain training content as appropriate for specific audience level (management, general staff etc…). \- Continuous Improvement: \- Set examples by leading improvement initiatives through cross\-functional teams ensuring successes. \- Identify and encourage people to adopt practices better than the industry standard. \- Continuously encourage and recognise the importance of thinking out\-of\-the\-box within the team. \- Encourage, solicit and reward innovative ideas even in day\-to\-day issues. \- Lead the development and implementation of processes and systems to identify and assess risk in card and merchant services. \- Ensure that risk management practices and systems are integrated into product development processes and are consistent with regulatory requirements. \- Oversee the development and implementation of risk management training and awareness programs, promoting a culture of risk management and awareness. \- Conduct regular assessments of risk management practices and system.
* Learning \& Knowledge: \- Possess a good knowledge of the risk involved in all card products (credit/debit/prepaid/contactless) and merchant payment channels (POS, eCommerce, MO/TO …) and good knowledge of related operations, controls and regulatory framework. \- Identify areas for professional development of self. \- Proactively identify areas for professional development of self and undertake development activities. \- Seek out opportunities to remain current with all developments in professional field. \- Hold meetings with staff and assess their performance and your teams overall performance on a regular basis. \- Take decisive action to ensure speedy resolution of unresolved grievances or conflicts within the team members. \- Identify development opportunities and activities for staff and facilitate/coach them to improve their effectives and prepare them to assume greater responsibilities.
* Legal, Regulatory, and Risk Framework Responsibilities: \- Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML \& CTF, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy). \- Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defence principle to identify measure, monitor, manage and report risks. \- Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy. \- Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements. \- Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role. \- Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank, attain, and maintain the required levels of competence. \- Attend mandatory (internal and external) seminars as instructed by the Bank.
* Other: \- Ensure high standards of data protection and confidentiality to safeguard commercially sensitive information. \- Maintaining utmost confidentiality concerning customer and internal bank information obtained during the course of business and provide such information on a need to know basis only to Senior Management of QNB, Audit and Compliance functions, and relevant Regulators. \- Maintain high professional standards to uphold QNB's reputation and to strengthen its market leadership position. \- All other ad hoc duties/activities related to QNB that management might request from time to time. \- Work closely with external customers and internal teams providing oversight, guidance in relation to Merchant Acquiring Risk.


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* University Bachelor’s Degree graduate preferably with a Major in Marketing, Banking, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or Information Technology (related field of study).
* At least 12 years of relevant experience, preferably within a highly rated international bank or regulatory agency, of which at least 5 years should be in a managerial/ supervisory role.


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Copy of Passport or QID
* Copy of Education Certificate

**Graduate Trainee Programme \- Qatar Nationals Only
   

  

 Location: Doha, Qatar**
**About HSBC**
 HSBC is one of the world’s leading banks, with a network covering 67 countries and territories. Our global reach means we offer many ways for you to develop your career. We offer an inclusive, values\-led culture, tailored learning and development programmes and competitive benefits. We have roles in retail, commercial, investment and private banking and a range of operational and functional teams.
   

  

**OUR STRUCTURE**
 Our network covers both established and emerging markets across Europe, Asia\-Pacific, Middle East and North Africa, North America and Latin America. Within these markets, we serve our customers through our global businesses: Commercial Banking, Global Banking and Markets, Global Private Banking, and Retails Banking and Wealth Management.
   

  

**The Graduate Programme** 
 is a two year rotational programme offering ‘on the job’ training experience in a fast paced dynamic environment for new and recent graduates.
   

  

 The programme focuses on providing participants with professional development opportunities and real time tailored personal growth opportunities.
   

  

 HSBC Graduate Programmes Are All Underpinned By The Same Desire; To Maximise Your Chances Of Becoming a Highly Effective Leader In a Market\-leading Global Organisation. To Help Realise This Goal, Our Graduate Scheme Provides a Range Of Leadership Development That Run Parallel To The Business\-specific Training You’ll Receive. We’re Very Confident You’ll Be Fully Supported Along The Way, And Here’s Why
   

  

**Mentoring Scheme:** 
 You’ll be assigned a senior mentor within the business. They’ll have real insight into how best to manage your career, and they’ll be available for advice and guidance at the times you need them most.
   

  

**Communication, Influencing and Business Partnering:** 
 This programme provides you the ability to work effectively across the organisation and will be critical to your future success. This programme will challenge your thinking and really develop your interpersonal style and skills.
   

  

**Teamwork:** 
 Maximising team performance is a skill we’ll be keen to help you develop. Short courses and individual coaching will seek to help you develop your understanding of team dynamics and your impact on others.
   

  

**Job Rotations:** 
 Four six\-month placements will provide you with specialist knowledge of our operations with the below business areas.
   

  

 HSBC graduate careers provide specialist development in specific areas of the Bank’s Qatar operations, and whichever route you take, you’ll be sure to get your career off to a great start. We will work with you to understand your areas of interest and your aspirations and offer placement opportunities available.
   

  

**We Have Roles Available In The Following Business Areas**
* Global Banking and Markets Global Banking and Markets focuses on building strong partnerships with our clients and using our global network to help them achieve consistent, long\-term performance. Our understanding of long\-term economic trends and insight into opportunities on an international level enables us to develop product and services for governments, corporates and institutions.
* Commercial Banking HSBC Commercial Banking operates in around 60 countries and territories, covering the developed and developing markets that matter most to our customers. Through our teams of relationship managers we connect businesses to opportunities, helping them to thrive and grow.
* Retail Banking and Wealth Management Retail Banking and Wealth Management serves more than 50 million customers worldwide. Our employees help customers to manage their day\-to\-day finances and save for the future. We offer career opportunities ranging from customer service and relationship management jobs in branches to roles in product development, sales, strategy, asset management and insurance. Generalist, specialist and managerial roles are available at all levels.
* HSBC Operations, Services and Technology HSBC Operations, Services and Technology (HOST) provides essential operational services, IT and technical support to help the HSBC Group function effectively on a day\-to\-day basis. We use our expertise and technology to improve the bank’s customer service and efficiency. HSBC Operations, Services and Technology (HOST) has responsibilities that include: Running customer service operations and business processes from contact centres to payments processing\| Developing software and applications that underpin HSBC’s banking systems, Managing IT systems, infrastructure and support, Implementing major strategic change programmes, Procuring goods and services for the Group, Managing HSBC’s global corporate real estate portfolio.
* Global Functions HSBC’s Global Functions (GF) play a vital role in supporting the bank’s Global Businesses and offer a broad range of career opportunities in areas from legal, risk and finance to human resources, sustainability, marketing and communications. Our operational and functional teams around the world help HSBC’s Global Businesses to operate efficiently and effectively on a day\-to\-day basis. They also focus on controls and governance to reduce risk and protect the Group’s reputation.


**Knowledge \& Experience / Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
* Knowledge of international business and various industry sectors
* Exposure to and appreciation of working in a global environment
* Strong ‘team’ skills promoting an environment of co\-operation and trust, overcoming resistance where encountered
* Possess analytical and financial skills
* Good prioritizing, organizational and time management abilities
* Ability to make decisions
* Good verbal and written communications skills


**WHY HSBC?**
 We put diversity at the heart of our business and we take our responsibility to develop our talent seriously.
   

  

 Joining HSBC will give you the chance to work in a collegiate, supportive and inclusive environment in which we seek to develop and promote people based on merit. We will provide you with tailored training and support to help you identify and follow your chosen career path, as well as access to a range of market\-competitive benefits.
   

  

**What To Expect At HSBC**
* The chance to realise your ambitions
* Globally connected careers
* A strong emphasis on values
* Learning and development opportunities
* An inclusive, meritocratic culture
* Market\-competitive benefits


**Global Careers Opportunities**
 Visit our Global Careers site where you can explore our business, meet our people and find useful application hints and tips http://www.hsbc.com/careers

**About Commercial Bank**
 Commercial Bank, founded in 1975 and headquartered in Doha, plays a vital role in Qatar’s economic development by offering a range of personal, business, government, international and investment services. We believe in empowering our employees, providing them with opportunities for growth and professional development.
   

  

 By Joining us, you’ll be part of a workplace culture that fosters innovation, supports work\-life balance, and encourages you to reach your full potential.
   

  

 Join us in shaping the future of banking!
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Head of Security Operations is responsible for ensuring the organization’s information assets remain secure, resilient, and available. In this dual capacity, the role not only leads the operational defense of the enterprise—managing the Security Operations Center (SOC), incident response, threat detection, and vulnerability management—but also supports the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) in shaping and executing the broader cybersecurity strategy.
   

  

 The role requires a balance of technical expertise and leadership, driving continuous improvement in monitoring, detection, and response capabilities while also contributing to policy development, security awareness, and long\-term resilience planning.
   

  

 The Head of Security Operations will establish robust processes, optimize security tools, and ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulations.
   

  

 This position provides strategic oversight across Security Operations acting as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and a bridge between technical teams and executive stakeholders. It ensures that security operations are tightly aligned with enterprise risk objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. By coordinating with other security, IT, and business teams, this role ensures that security operations are efficient, proactive, and strategically aligned.
   

  

 Ultimately, the Head of Security Operations acts as both the guardian of the organization’s digital environment and a key leader in advancing enterprise\-wide cybersecurity maturity, ensuring threats are identified and mitigated quickly while evolving controls to meet emerging challenges.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities \& Responsibilities**
 Operational Leadership
   

  

* Oversee day\-to\-day security operations, including Security Operations Center (SOC), incident response, threat detection, and vulnerability management.
* Ensure timely triage, investigation, and resolution of security incidents.
* Maintain and optimize security monitoring tools, SIEM, and endpoint protection platforms.
* Develop and enforce operational runbooks, escalation procedures, and SLAs for incident handling.


 Strategic Responsibilities
   

  

* Define and execute the Security Operations strategy aligned with organizational risk appetite and business objectives.
* Drive continuous improvement through automation, threat intelligence integration, and advanced analytics.
* Collaborate with architecture and engineering teams to design secure solutions for new business initiatives.
* Lead maturity assessments and roadmap development for SOC capabilities.


 Business Alignment
   

  

* Act as a trusted advisor to business units, ensuring security controls support operational efficiency and customer trust.
* Translate technical risks into business impact for executive reporting.
* Collaborating with IT, legal, and business units to align security with organizational objectives.


**Key Competencies**
* Strategic Leadership
* Ability to define and execute a long\-term security operations vision to combat existing and future threats.
* Risk Management
* Expertise in identifying, assessing, and mitigating cyber risks.
* Strong understanding of regulatory and compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST, QCB and NCSA)
* Technical Acumen
* Deep knowledge of security operations cybersecurity technologies
* Familiarity with emerging threats and security innovations.
* Incident Response \& Crisis Management
* Capability to lead during security breaches and ransomware attacks.
* Communication \& Stakeholder Engagement
* Ability to translate technical risks into business language for executives and regulators.
* Strong presentation and negotiation skills.
* Governance \& Compliance
* Experience in implementing security policies, audits, and regulatory reporting.
* Liaison with regulators and external auditors.
* People Leadership
* Build and lead high\-performing security teams.
* Drive a culture of security awareness across the organization.
* Analytical \& Decision\-Making Skills
* Data\-driven approach to security investments and risk prioritization.
* Ability to make quick, informed decisions under pressure.


**Qualifications \& Expereince**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or related field; advanced degree (Master’s or MBA) preferred.
* 15\+ years in cybersecurity, with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles driving enterprise\-wide security initiatives.
* Certifications: CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, CCSP, or equivalent industry\-recognized credentials.
* Extensive experience managing SOC operations and large\-scale incident response, including crisis management and executive\-level communications.
* Proven track record in developing and implementing enterprise security strategies, aligning technical controls with business risk and regulatory requirements (PCI DSS, ISO27001, NIST, GDPR).
* Expertise in governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) frameworks, including policy development, audit readiness, and regulatory engagement.
* Strong background in cloud security (Azure, AWS, GCP), identity management, and data protection, with hands\-on experience in Microsoft security tools (Purview, Entra ID, Defender).
* Leadership in building and mentoring high\-performing security teams, fostering collaboration across IT, risk, and business units.
* Experience in vendor and third\-party risk management, ensuring secure supply chain practices and resilience.
* Skilled in workflow automation and orchestration (e.g., SOAR) to optimize detection, response, and compliance processes.
* Adept at executive and board\-level communication, translating complex technical risks into clear business impacts and strategic recommendations.
* Demonstrated success in driving digital transformation securely, balancing innovation with robust risk management and regulatory oversight.


**Why Commercial Bank**
* Best Performing Bank in Qatar in The Banker’s prestigious Top 1000 World Banks Rankings 2025\.
* Best Digital Bank in the Middle East 2024 by World Finance and Best Mobile Banking App in the Middle East 2024 by Global Finance.

 What you'll do: Elicit what entities really need, map the processes, and turn it into clear, build ready requirements.

 Elicit, analyze, and document requirements from many government entities and stakeholders
   

 Map current state and future state processes, and model them clearly, for example in BPMN

 Facilitate workshops, and resolve conflicting requirements into one coherent picture
   

 Run gap, impact, and feasibility analysis, and surface risks and dependencies early
   

 Maintain requirements traceability from need through to delivered feature
   

 Partner with product, architecture, and engineering, and support user acceptance testing
   

 Validate that delivered solutions actually meet the requirements, and close the loop

 You have been the senior business analyst on complex software, and your specs got built
   

 You are excellent at elicitation and facilitation, and you draw out what stakeholders actually need
   

 You model and map processes clearly, and you write crisp, unambiguous requirements
   

 You bridge business and engineering, and both sides trust your translation
   

 You turn conflicting, messy demands into one ordered, agreed picture
   

 You hold a Bachelor's or higher in a relevant field; business analysis certifications are a plus
   

 You are rigorous about traceability, and nothing important falls through the cracks
   

 Bonus points for government, public sector, or regulated process work
   

 Fluent English required; Arabic is a valuable advantage
   

  

 If you turn government complexity into requirements teams can build, do it here. Apply.

 CE \& Projects Department

**Your new role**
 As our new Data \& Digital Solutions Partner, you will own the execution of digital projects, channel optimization and platform management across our Saudi Arabia affiliate. You will be the driving force behind best\-in\-class consumer and customer experiences, working at the intersection of business strategy, technology and patient impact.
   

  

**Your Day\-to\-day Responsibilities Will Include**
* Building, maintaining and upgrading Novo Nordisk\-owned digital platforms and solutions, including consumer engagement platforms, digital health solutions and patient support ecosystems.
* Leading the development of data solutions across the business value chain to support strategic priorities and deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Identifying opportunities and platforms to drive business growth and enhance customer and consumer engagement through digital ecosystems and data\-driven solutions.
* Overseeing the implementation, maintenance and continuous improvement of local digital initiatives, ensuring alignment with the broader Novo Nordisk ecosystem.
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams locally, regionally and globally, as well as with external technology partners, to deliver scalable and sustainable solutions.
* Ensuring strong governance, compliance and alignment of all digital solutions with business needs, regulatory requirements and organisational standards.
* Supporting the rollout of new digital capabilities and contributing to the evolution of omnichannel, digital marketing and digital health initiatives.


**Your new department**
 As part of International Operations, you will join our largest operational unit. Covering 194 countries and 95% of the world's population, more than 18,000 of us work passionately to serve 35 million patients each day. With a promise to outperform the competition, we continue to be the growth driver for Novo Nordisk, and to improve health at scale across the globe.
   

  

 You will join the CE \& Projects department in Saudi Arabia, reporting directly to the Director of CE \& Projects. Working closely with our local Leadership Team, frontline Marketing, Medical, Sales \& Access colleagues, and global Digital \& CE teams, you will play a pivotal role in shaping how we engage with customers and consumers in one of our most strategically important markets.
   

  

**Your Skills \& Qualifications**
 We're looking for a digitally savvy, outcome\-oriented professional who thrives in a fast\-paced, regulated environment and knows how to turn customer insight into impactful business action. To succeed in this role, you'll bring:
   

  

* A university degree in Business, Strategy, Innovation, Computer Science or a related field; an advanced degree (MBA or similar, ideally within IT strategy) is preferred.
* A minimum of 5\-7 years' experience in Data \& Digital solutions implementation, digital/IT/business management, or a related discipline – ideally gained in FMCG, life sciences or another regulated industry.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing channels, digital health and patient services solutions, website and social media analytics tools, paid media channels and web traffic drivers.
* A demonstrated track record of managing large\-scale projects that deliver tangible business outcomes, paired with strong analytical capability, strategic leadership and the ability to synthesise insights into clear direction.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to lead without authority, drive change and secure buy\-in across diverse audiences.
* Fluency in both Arabic and English, written and spoken.


**Working at Novo Nordisk**
 At Novo Nordisk, every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long\-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.
   

  

**Deadline: June 18th, 2026**
 We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
   

  

 At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long\-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

 Kuwait Dairy Company (KDCow) is a leading dairy producer in Kuwait, known for high\-quality fresh dairy products made from milk sourced daily from local farms. Established in 1960 through a Kuwaiti farmers’ initiative, the company plays a key role in supporting national food security and enhancing local industrial capabilities. KDCow operates extensive production lines over a 22,000 square meter facility, with a current daily capacity of 350 tons and plans to expand to 550 tons. A dedicated research and quality control team works in internationally accredited laboratories to ensure products meet global health standards and to drive continuous improvement. The company is also developing a major new 70,000 square meter extension to further increase production and supply capacity in Kuwait and across the GCC.

The Information Technology Manager leads and mentors the IT team, prioritizes support requests, and ensures timely resolution of incidents and service requests. The role collaborates closely with operations, production, finance, and senior leadership to understand business needs, implement technology solutions, and support ongoing expansion projects. * Drive a responsible AI approach, including model monitoring, drift detection, explainability, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows where required.
* Own the architecture and engineering roadmap from pilot through MVP to scale, ensuring systems are secure, scalable, and maintainable.

 You're probably a fit if…
   

  

* You have proven experience shipping AI/ML\-powered products into production; not just prototypes.

* You have experience in fintech, lending, BNPL, payments, risk, fraud, or underwriting, and understand the importance of correctness in these environments.
* You have a track record of turning complex datasets into real\-world decision tools with measurable business impact.
* You have hired, mentored, and led teams in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments.
* You take full ownership of outcomes and maintain high standards for reliability, security, and scalable architecture.
* You communicate clearly with engineers, executives, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* You are based in Riyadh or open to relocation; this is an on\-site leadership role.
* Bonus: Experience with credit bureaus, alternative data, open banking signals, cloud\-native architectures at scale, regulated environments, or GCC fintech products.


**THE ENVIRONMENT** 
 : What working here actually looks like.
   

  

* Builder Role, Real Scope: You won’t be maintaining an existing system; you’ll define the architecture, build the team, and own outcomes from day one.
* AI at the Core: AI is central to how TradePay operates, from underwriting to risk monitoring and merchant intelligence, and you will lead that effort.
* Close to the Top: You will work directly with the CEO and leadership team in Riyadh, with fast feedback loops and real influence on company direction.


**What You Get From Us**

* Meaningful equity: Real upside tied to the long\-term value you help create.
* Premium gear, day one: Fully set up and ready before your first day.
* Mentorship that matters: Learn from people who have built and scaled ventures.
* An accelerated curve: You’ll learn more here in 12 months than most roles offer in three years.

Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
   

  

 Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
   

  

 Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.
   

  

**Background and Context**
 Digital \& Technology sits at the heart of Haleon’s ambition to Win as One. We are Haleon’s digital backbone – how we accelerate impact, unlock new value, and build a future‑ready organisation. Digital isn’t simply part of our business; it is how we operate, grow, and deliver everyday health at scale.
   

  

 The Digital \& Technology function plays a critical role as a strategic partner to the business, turning insights into impact and ideas into innovation. From secure, resilient operations and modern digital foundations, to hyper‑personalised customer and consumer experiences, digital is embedded across every part of Haleon – shaping how we innovate, supply consumer demand, go to market, and run our internal operations.
   

  

 Our focus is clear: to secure the business, run resilient and compliant operations, and transform Haleon into a digital organisation that is wired for excellence. This is enabled by sustained investment in a scalable, resilient technology foundation and the adoption of digital solutions that empower our people, elevate performance, and enable the 4–6% organic revenue growth and productivity savings underpinning Win as One.
   

  

 Digital only delivers when people are at the centre. Building skills, confidence, and modern ways of working is essential to realising value from technology. Together, we are reshaping the backbone of Haleon to become a best‑in‑class consumer health company – bold, resilient, performance‑focused, and fit for the future.
   

  

**Role Overview**
* The Senior OU Tech Partner (UAE) is a senior Organisational Unit (OU) Digital \& Technology partner accountable for delivering business\-critical digital capabilities that enable commercial growth and operational excellence across the MEA OU.
* The role is responsible for the day\-to\-day delivery and operational management of digital and technology capabilities supporting Haleon’s OU priorities in the MEA. Acting as the primary technology partner to OU business leaders, this role ensures digital priorities are translated into reliable, scalable solutions aligned to global platforms and standards.
* The focus is on execution excellence, adoption, operational performance, and measurable business impact, rather than enterprise or regional strategy ownership.
* The role requires experience delivering digital capabilities across sales, marketing, eCommerce, and digital platforms, alongside operational technologies such as infrastructure and security.
* Combining strong commercial understanding with execution leadership, the Senior OU Tech Partner owns end\-to\-end delivery, adoption, and performance of digital initiatives, while ensuring alignment with Haleon’s global roadmaps, governance, and ways of working.
* Success in this role is driven by delivery excellence, business impact, stakeholder leadership, and the ability to operate effectively within a complex, matrixed global environment.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Delivery \& Execution:**
* Deliver agreed digital and technology initiatives supporting OU priorities in the MEA.
* Translate defined roadmaps and plans into clear delivery activities, milestones, and outcomes.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery accountability for key OU initiatives, ensuring measurable business outcomes (e.g. growth, productivity, adoption).
* Coordinate and lead delivery across internal teams, global platform partners, and vendors
* Coordinate delivery across internal teams, global platform partners, and vendors to ensure timely execution.
* Track progress, risks, and dependencies, escalating issues proactively.


**Business \& Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Work closely with OU Marketing, Sales, Customer, and Corporate teams to clarify requirements and support delivery.
* Partner with commercial leaders to align digital initiatives with market growth priorities, ensuring technology investments deliver tangible business value.
* Bring strong understanding of commercial drivers (sales execution, distribution, customer engagement, eCommerce) into solution delivery.
* Act as the primary day‑to‑day technology contact for assigned domains or initiatives.
* Build strong working relationships with business stakeholders to enable adoption and value realisation.


**Matrix \& Global Collaboration**
* Partner with global product, engineering, and platform teams to deliver MEA OU requirements in line with global standards.
* Contribute delivery feedback and local insights to support continuous improvement of global platforms and services.


**Governance, Risk \& Compliance**
* Ensure delivery activities follow secure‑by‑design principles and established architecture standards.
* Apply global IT governance, risk, and compliance frameworks within assigned scope.
* Support compliance with local regulatory, data privacy, and security requirements.


**Operations \& Financial Management**
* Monitor operational performance of owned digital and technology services and support issue resolution with global teams.
* Support budget tracking, vendor coordination, and benefits tracking for assigned initiatives.


**Team \& Capability Contribution**
* Lead cross\-functional delivery teams and workstreams across markets, global platform teams, and vendors.
* Provide direction, prioritisation, and decision support across complex initiatives.
* Act as a senior point of escalation for delivery, adoption, and performance challenges.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 10\+ years’ experience in digital, technology, or commercial technology roles, including leadership of complex delivery initiatives.
* Experience delivering digital capabilities across sales, marketing, eCommerce, CRM, or digital experience platforms.
* Experience working in a matrixed, global organisation, partnering with central product and platform teams.
* Exposure to technology operations, vendors, or delivery partners.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Clear communicator, able to engage both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
* Experience in CPG, retail, or consumer‑led environments advantageous.


**Job Posting End Date**
 2026\-06\-15
   

  

**Equal Opportunities**
 Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
   

  

 During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
   

  

 The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
   

  

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
 If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.
   

  

**Note to candidates**
 The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

**Job Description**
**About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**The mission**
 We believe the transformative potential of AI is significantly under\-realised in our region. To bridge this gap, we are incubating a new division within Careem dedicated to Enterprise AI Transformation.
   

  

 We are reimagining and building the future of work to simplify and improve how businesses function in the era of GenAI with WorkOS: a next\-generation ‘operating system’ designed to deploy, orchestrate, and improve AI agents across every customer and operational journey (and increasingly autonomously). This isn’t just automation; it’s about creating a hybrid workforce where self\-learning AI agents handle the heavy lifting, empowering our people to focus on the highest\-value, most creative work.
   

  

**The team**
 This group operates as a
 **startup within Careem** 
 with a distinct mandate: move fast, build boldly, and deliver production\-grade AI systems that fundamentally change how the region leverages technology.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a
 **Founding Forward Deployed Engineer \- WorkOS \- Enterprise Agentic AI** 
 to be the vanguard of the WorkOS mission. This is a role for a "heretic": someone who cares more about solving the problem and delivering value than following a rigid spec. You will be the bridge between our core AI engine and the messy, high\-stakes reality of our customers’ operations.
   

  

 As an FDE, you aren't sitting in the back office; you are on the front lines, embedded with internal Careem verticals and external enterprise partners. In partnership with your implementation squad, consisting also of business transformation consultants, you will identify their deepest friction points and build the "special ops" code that proves the power of WorkOS. Your work is the proof of concept that will redefine how the region works.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Tip of the Spear: Lead the deployment of WorkOS in the field. You will be responsible for understanding a customer's operational "chaos" and architecting an AI\-driven solution that fixes it in weeks, not months.
* Rapid\-Fire Execution: Build, iterate, and ship. You will write high\-quality, full\-stack code to create bespoke integrations and augment our platform’s core capabilities and create custom agents. This goes beyond context engineering; you’ll build the connective tissue \- integrating bespoke APIs, setting up RAGs and Evals, tuning the E2E system and performance, and architecting multi\-agent handoffs.
* Feedback Loop Mastery: You are the eyes and ears of the product team. You will translate field\-tested insights into core product requirements, ensuring WorkOS remains grounded in real\-world utility.
* Winning Stakeholders: Act as the technical face of WorkOS. You’ll need to win the trust of stakeholders, navigate complex enterprise hierarchies, and persuade skeptics by shipping results that speak for themselves.
* Technical Versatility: One day you’re setting up a RAG pipeline; the next, you’re debugging a legacy enterprise API or designing a custom dashboard. You do whatever is necessary to make the solution land.


**What You’ll Need**
* 5–8\+ years of high\-octane engineering experience. You are likely a senior\-level engineer who is "hungrier" than your peers and bored by traditional, slow\-moving dev cycles.
* The FDE Pedigree: Experience in forward\-deployed, mission\-driven environments (e.g., Palantir, high\-growth startups, or specialized consultancy) where you worked directly with customers.
* Full\-Stack Polyglot: Mastery of the modern stack (React/TS, Python/Node) with the ability to jump into any codebase and be productive on day one.
* AI Fluidity: Strong working knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, and agentic frameworks. You don't just know the theory; you know how to make AI work in production.
* Excellent Communication: You are a "social engineer." You can explain complex AI logic to a CEO and then pivot to a deep\-dive session with an infrastructure lead without missing a beat.
* Relentless Bias for Action: You are a builder who values shipping over perfection. You have a "founder\-level" sense of ownership and aren't afraid to get your hands dirty.
* Willingness to work on\-site full time in UAE, with occasional travel to be embedded with regional partners.


**What You’ll Receive**
* A Blank Canvas and Live Ammunition: The rare opportunity to build a "0\-to\-1" product while immediately deploying it into the real\-world operations of a regional giant. No "sandbox" projects here, you’ll be shipping code that moves people and goods on day one. This is a huge opportunity to create impact in our region.
* A Special Ops Mission: We’re a lean, impact\-obsessed team operating with total autonomy. You’ll be free from corporate bureaucracy and legacy baggage, focused entirely on winning the customer and solving "unsolvable" problems.
* Direct Collaboration with Leadership: Direct engagement with Careem and enterprise client leadership, in addition to working side\-by\-side with the WorkOS founding team including Magnus Olsson (Careem’s original Co\-founder).
* Competitive Compensation: Including direct equity in this new division. Our philosophy is meritocratic: we want you to own a meaningful stake in the value you create.


**What We’ll Provide You**

data.jd_text:
**About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**The mission**
 We believe the transformative potential of AI is significantly under\-realised in our region. To bridge this gap, we are incubating a new division within Careem dedicated to Enterprise AI Transformation.
   

  

 We are reimagining and building the future of work to simplify and improve how businesses function in the era of GenAI with WorkOS: a next\-generation ‘operating system’ designed to deploy, orchestrate, and improve AI agents across every customer and operational journey (and increasingly autonomously). This isn’t just automation; it’s about creating a hybrid workforce where self\-learning AI agents handle the heavy lifting, empowering our people to focus on the highest\-value, most creative work.
   

  

**The team**
 This group operates as a
 **startup within Careem** 
 with a distinct mandate: move fast, build boldly, and deliver production\-grade AI systems that fundamentally change how the region leverages technology.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a
 **Founding Forward Deployed Engineer \- WorkOS \- Enterprise Agentic AI** 
 to be the vanguard of the WorkOS mission. This is a role for a "heretic": someone who cares more about solving the problem and delivering value than following a rigid spec. You will be the bridge between our core AI engine and the messy, high\-stakes reality of our customers’ operations.
   

  

 As an FDE, you aren't sitting in the back office; you are on the front lines, embedded with internal Careem verticals and external enterprise partners. In partnership with your implementation squad, consisting also of business transformation consultants, you will identify their deepest friction points and build the "special ops" code that proves the power of WorkOS. Your work is the proof of concept that will redefine how the region works.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Tip of the Spear: Lead the deployment of WorkOS in the field. You will be responsible for understanding a customer's operational "chaos" and architecting an AI\-driven solution that fixes it in weeks, not months.
* Rapid\-Fire Execution: Build, iterate, and ship. You will write high\-quality, full\-stack code to create bespoke integrations and augment our platform’s core capabilities and create custom agents. This goes beyond context engineering; you’ll build the connective tissue \- integrating bespoke APIs, setting up RAGs and Evals, tuning the E2E system and performance, and architecting multi\-agent handoffs.
* Feedback Loop Mastery: You are the eyes and ears of the product team. You will translate field\-tested insights into core product requirements, ensuring WorkOS remains grounded in real\-world utility.
* Winning Stakeholders: Act as the technical face of WorkOS. You’ll need to win the trust of stakeholders, navigate complex enterprise hierarchies, and persuade skeptics by shipping results that speak for themselves.
* Technical Versatility: One day you’re setting up a RAG pipeline; the next, you’re debugging a legacy enterprise API or designing a custom dashboard. You do whatever is necessary to make the solution land.


**What You’ll Need**
* 5–8\+ years of high\-octane engineering experience. You are likely a senior\-level engineer who is "hungrier" than your peers and bored by traditional, slow\-moving dev cycles.
* The FDE Pedigree: Experience in forward\-deployed, mission\-driven environments (e.g., Palantir, high\-growth startups, or specialized consultancy) where you worked directly with customers.
* Full\-Stack Polyglot: Mastery of the modern stack (React/TS, Python/Node) with the ability to jump into any codebase and be productive on day one.
* AI Fluidity: Strong working knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, and agentic frameworks. You don't just know the theory; you know how to make AI work in production.
* Excellent Communication: You are a "social engineer." You can explain complex AI logic to a CEO and then pivot to a deep\-dive session with an infrastructure lead without missing a beat.
* Relentless Bias for Action: You are a builder who values shipping over perfection. You have a "founder\-level" sense of ownership and aren't afraid to get your hands dirty.
* Willingness to work on\-site full time in UAE, with occasional travel to be embedded with regional partners.


**What You’ll Receive**
* A Blank Canvas and Live Ammunition: The rare opportunity to build a "0\-to\-1" product while immediately deploying it into the real\-world operations of a regional giant. No "sandbox" projects here, you’ll be shipping code that moves people and goods on day one. This is a huge opportunity to create impact in our region.
* A Special Ops Mission: We’re a lean, impact\-obsessed team operating with total autonomy. You’ll be free from corporate bureaucracy and legacy baggage, focused entirely on winning the customer and solving "unsolvable" problems.
* Direct Collaboration with Leadership: Direct engagement with Careem and enterprise client leadership, in addition to working side\-by\-side with the WorkOS founding team including Magnus Olsson (Careem’s original Co\-founder).
* Competitive Compensation: Including direct equity in this new division. Our philosophy is meritocratic: we want you to own a meaningful stake in the value you create.


**What We’ll Provide You**
 We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:
   

  

* Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
* Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
* Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
* Work remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.

data.jd_text:
Our client is a VARA\-regulated Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP) committed to maintaining the highest standards of security, governance, regulatory compliance, and operational resilience. We are seeking an experienced Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead the firm's technology strategy, cybersecurity framework, digital asset infrastructure, and operational technology governance.
 



 The CTO will serve as a key function holder responsible for ensuring the security, availability, scalability, and regulatory compliance of the firm's technology environment, including trading systems, wallet infrastructure, custody integrations, and cybersecurity controls
 



 .
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Technology Leadership** 



* Develop and execute the company's technology strategy in alignment with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
* Oversee all technology platforms supporting virtual asset activities, including trading infrastructure, liquidity integrations, custody solutions, and operational systems.
* Ensure high availability, resilience, and scalability of all technology services.



**Cybersecurity \& Information Security** 



* Own and maintain the Information Security Management Framework.
* Lead cybersecurity governance, risk assessments, vulnerability management, penetration testing, and incident response programs.
* Ensure compliance with VARA cybersecurity, technology governance, and operational resilience requirements.
* Report material technology and cyber risks to senior management and the Board.



**Digital Asset Infrastructure \& Wallet Governance** 



* Oversee wallet management architecture and security controls.
* Ensure appropriate governance around key management, MPC arrangements, transaction authorization processes, and access controls.
* Review and approve wallet security policies and procedures.
* Coordinate with custody providers and third\-party service providers supporting wallet operations.



**Regulatory \& Compliance Responsibilities** 



* Act as a key technology representative during regulatory reviews, audits, and inspections.
* Support the preparation and maintenance of regulatory submissions, business plans, policies, and governance documentation.
* Ensure technology operations align with AML/CFT, data protection, outsourcing, and cybersecurity requirements.
* Maintain appropriate documentation and evidence of technology governance activities.



**Third\-Party \& Vendor Management** 



* Oversee relationships with liquidity providers, custody providers, technology vendors, cloud providers, and cybersecurity service providers.
* Conduct due diligence and ongoing monitoring of critical service providers.
* Assess concentration risks associated with technology and operational dependencies.



**Governance \& Reporting** 



* Participate in management committees and governance forums.
* Provide regular reporting on technology performance, cybersecurity posture, operational resilience, and emerging risks.
* Support business continuity planning and disaster recovery testing.



**Required Qualifications** 




**Education** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree preferred.



**Professional Certifications (Preferred)** 



* CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
* CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)
* CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor)
* CCSP, AWS Security, or equivalent cloud\-security certifications
* Blockchain or digital asset security certifications are advantageous



**Experience Requirements** 



* Minimum 10 years of technology leadership experience.
* Minimum 5 years in financial services, fintech, digital assets, cryptocurrency exchanges, custody providers, or regulated financial institutions.
* Demonstrated experience implementing cybersecurity and information security frameworks.
* Experience with wallet infrastructure, MPC technology, key management controls, and digital asset custody solutions.
* Experience engaging with financial regulators and regulatory examinations.
* Experience managing third\-party technology and security vendors.



**Technical Competencies** 



* Information security governance and risk management.
* Cloud infrastructure and architecture.
* Blockchain technologies and digital asset ecosystems.
* Wallet security and key management controls.
* Network security and incident response.
* Technology operations and resilience management.
* Regulatory technology and compliance frameworks.



**Leadership Competencies** 



* Strong ethical standards and integrity.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to challenge and escalate technology risks appropriately.
* Strong decision\-making and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to operate within a regulated environment.



**Fit and Proper Requirements** 




 The successful candidate must:
 


* Be of good repute, integrity, and professional standing.
* Have no history of fraud, financial misconduct, regulatory sanctions, or serious disciplinary actions.
* Demonstrate competence, capability, and relevant experience for the role.
* Be capable of performing the responsibilities of a senior management function within a VARA\-regulated VASP.
* Successfully complete background screening, reference checks, and regulatory fit\-and\-proper assessments.
* Disclose any conflicts of interest, outside business activities, or regulatory investigations.
* Meet all applicable VARA requirements for key personnel and senior management appointments.



**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* Technology platform uptime and resilience.
* Cybersecurity maturity and incident management effectiveness.
* Regulatory compliance and audit outcomes.
* Successful completion of security assessments and penetration tests.
* Timely remediation of technology and security risks.
* Operational efficiency and scalability of technology infrastructure.
* Effective governance and oversight of wallet and custody arrangements.

**Job Purpose** 




 The Platform Owner — Cards is accountable for the end‑to‑end run and change lifecycle of RAKBANK’s cards technology platforms, including TSYS Prime 4, TSYS Online Authorization, and post‑facto fraud systems, managing them as a strategic internal bank product. The role ensures platform stability, availability, fraud effectiveness, and API‑driven capability exposure in a millisecond‑critical, scheme‑governed environment, while driving continuous evolution to support new card products, digital wallets, tokenisation, contactless payments, and UAE local and international scheme mandates. Acting as the bank’s primary IT authority for cards, the Platform Owner leads specialist engineering and BA teams and represents the platform in business, scheme, and regulatory engagements, balancing operational excellence with forward‑looking innovation to meet the needs of Personal, SME, Commercial, and Corporate banking segments.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 



* Own the full run‑and‑change lifecycle of RAKBANK’s cards platforms (TSYS Prime 4, Online Authorization, post‑facto fraud), managing them as strategic internal products with defined SLOs, SLAs, and uptime KPIs.
* Ensure full compliance with UAE local payment scheme mandates alongside Visa and Mastercard requirements, managing certifications, timelines, and regulatory obligations.
* Drive platform innovation and future readiness to support new card products, digital wallets, tokenisation, BNPL, and emerging payment capabilities at scale.
* Deliver platform capabilities that meet the full needs of Personal, SME, Commercial, and Corporate banking segments, translating business requirements into robust technology solutions.
* Govern and expose cards capabilities through stable, well‑documented APIs, ensuring versioning discipline and protection for consuming channels and squads.
* Lead high‑precision platform operations, including real‑time authorisation health, BCP/DR readiness, major incident management, and root‑cause elimination.
* Oversee post‑facto fraud detection effectiveness, including rule tuning, performance metrics, and alignment with evolving UAE and regional fraud patterns.
* Manage all platform run activities, including patching, releases, PCI DSS compliance, infrastructure coordination, and scheme certification continuity.
* Lead and develop a high‑performance cards platform team with clear ownership, accountability, and continuous capability building.
* Own and report all run‑and‑change KPIs, technical roadmap, and operational efficiency initiatives, ensuring platform readiness ahead of business and programme demand.



**What You Will Bring:** 



* 15\+ years in banking technology with at least 5 years in a platform management, product ownership, or senior application management role covering card management systems.
* Hands\-on experience with TSYS Prime 4 (or an equivalent enterprise card management platform such as OpenWay WAY4, Compass Plus, or FIS CAMS) is strongly preferred; direct TSYS Prime 4 experience is a significant advantage.
* Deep functional knowledge of card products and operations across the full customer spectrum — consumer credit and debit, prepaid and virtual cards, SME business cards, commercial and large corporate card programmes — and the platform configuration required to support each segment.
* Proven experience managing UAE local payment scheme obligations and mandate delivery — familiarity with Al Etihad Payments, UAESWITCH domestic scheme requirements, and the interoperability framework governing card transactions within the UAE, alongside Visa and Mastercard international scheme management.
* Strong understanding of digital payments innovation — digital wallet integration (Apple Pay, Google Pay), EMV tokenisation, contactless payments, 3DS authentication, open banking card APIs, and BNPL integration.
* Experience managing the post\-facto fraud detection capability — including rule management, fraud analytics, detection effectiveness optimisation, and coordination with fraud operations teams.
* Strong understanding of PCI DSS requirements and their operational implications for card platform management and scheme certification.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* Prior experience in the same domain or hands\-on familiarity with the specific technologies relevant to this role will be considered a significant advantage during candidate evaluation.



**Desired Competencies:** 



* Cards platform ownership — TSYS Prime 4, authorisation, and fraud detection lifecycle
* UAE local scheme mandate management alongside Visa and Mastercard obligations
* Cards innovation — digital wallets, tokenisation, virtual cards, and segment\-specific product capability
* Multi\-segment cards domain expertise — personal banking, SME, commercial, and large corporate
* Real\-time authorisation platform operations and SLA/SLO governance
* PCI DSS compliance and scheme certification management
* API governance and stable cards platform interface design
* People leadership and cards technology team development

We are looking for an exceptional
 **General Manager** 
 to lead
 **Hakkasan Muscat** 
 , part of Hakkasan Group, home to the internationally acclaimed Hakkasan, Yauatcha, and Ling Ling brands.
 



  





**The Role** 




 This is an opportunity for a commercially driven and people focused hospitality leader to take ownership of a globally recognised luxury dining destination. You will lead all aspects of the operation, driving exceptional guest experience, strong financial performance, and a high performing team culture in line with the Hakkasan Group standards.
 



  





 This role is suited to a dynamic leader who thrives within fast\-paced, high volume luxury hospitality environments and has a passion for delivering elevated dining experiences.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead and oversee the full restaurant operation with accountability for guest experience, financial performance, team culture, and operational excellence
* Champion exceptional hospitality standards, ensuring every guest interaction feels personalised, seamless, and memorable
* Inspire, coach, and develop a high\-performing management and restaurant team through strong leadership and continuous development
* Drive commercial performance through strategic planning, labour management, cost control, and revenue optimisation
* Maintain exceptional standards across service, atmosphere, cleanliness, maintenance, and operational execution
* Partner with corporate teams on marketing initiatives, brand activations, events, and business development opportunities
* Ensure full compliance across health \& safety, licensing, labour regulations, and company policies



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Proven experience in a General Manager position within a fast\-paced luxury hospitality environment
* Previous experience within the Middle East hospitality market preferred
* Strong operational and commercial acumen with experience managing high\-volume restaurants and complex service operations
* Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop large teams
* Exceptional attention to detail and a passion for delivering elevated guest experiences
* Confident communicator with strong relationship building skills
* Naturally hands\-on, solutions focused, and highly organised
* Experience with luxury lifestyle, fine dining, or internationally recognised hospitality brands is highly desirable



  





 We offer a competitive package and the opportunity to grow within a globally recognised luxury hospitality brand.
